ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a high-contrast ratio of approximately 30% high-intensity pixels (localized white patch on the left lobe) to 70% low-intensity pixels (predominantly black right lobe and left fluke margins).

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark circular focal point is embedded within the upper region of the white pigmentation patch on the left lobe.
